records.title: Robust Dynamic Object Detection in Cluttered Indoor Scenes via Learned Spatiotemporal Cues
records.reading_boundary: III including fusion; IV setup, failure analysis, Tables I-III; no independent reproduction
records.selection_reason: Explicit multi-frame and ego-motion mechanism with a geometric-only ablation; useful counterpoint to category-only filtering.
evidence_locations: III-B: T=3 temporal model with body-frame velocity
III-C: 2D recovery of unmatched existing tracks; previous z
Table I: 31-obstacle human case at distThresh=0.25m, Dynablox recall 0.43 versus STORM 0.55
IV-C/D: sensing platform placed centrally in indoor experiments
Table III: GridNet mean 69.46 ms on tested laptop
limitations: Detection metrics do not establish improved SLAM or full navigation.
Reliance on prior tracks and height continuity; limited evidence for moving-ego localization errors.
Code marked to be released soon in paper; repository release not independently established.

records.title: DAWN: Noise-Robust Quadruped Parkour via Depth-Denoising World Models
records.reading_boundary: III, IV setup and ablations, Table II/III, IV-H and conclusion; no independent training or reproduction
records.selection_reason: Training-objective change isolated against noise-only and single-component ablations without extra deployed module.
evidence_locations: III-B/C: noisy input, clean reconstruction target and clean/noisy embedding alignment
Table I/III: shared architecture, changed training signals
IV-C: hardest-level full method +11.5 percentage points versus noise-only training
IV-H: outdoor 70 cm gap 60%, ten trials per difficulty
limitations: No universal unseen-noise guarantee; other depth sensors remain future work.
Not evaluated as dynamic-object filtering or localization correction.
